# v1.21.2 — Dispatch stop isolation and reliability

This stable release promotes v1.21.2b1 with the same runtime code. It includes
the dispatch lifecycle, write reliability, polling and dashboard-management
improvements described below, including for upgrades from v1.21.0 or earlier.

## Dispatch stop isolation

- Turning off an inactive dispatch switch no longer resets a different local controller's running session. This prevents cleanup sequences for alternative modes from erasing an active command and causing a later parameter update to report a read-back conflict.
- The requested switch still clears its own local state and callbacks. The active controller's session and deadline remain intact.
- Active-controller stops, explicit stops with no local owner, Dispatch Reset register values and verification, and external-conflict protection retain their existing behaviour.
- Conflict errors now include the observed register block and expected command arrays in the existing logs, service error and switch fault attribute. This diagnostic change adds no Modbus reads or writes.

## Included lifecycle and dashboard improvements

#### Dispatch fixes

- Dispatch Reset stops local controllers, timers and watchers before resetting, then checks the inverter directly to confirm dispatch has stopped.
- An unresolved reset raises an error, preventing normal HA recovery scripts from continuing as though it succeeded.
- Sync Dispatch State clears stale controls without claiming ownership of externally started dispatches. Legitimately paused Excess Export and Peak Shaving controllers are preserved.
- Prevent callbacks from older sessions sending commands after a stop, reset or restart.
- Keep inverter duration aligned with the session deadline. Power and cutoff-SoC updates send the remaining duration instead of extending the inverter's run time.
- Fix countdown information for deferred starts and remove unnecessary switch off/on transitions during successful restarts.

#### Write reliability and reloads

- Coalesce automatic setpoint updates so stale commands do not accumulate behind a slow connection.
- Add bounded retries for transient failures, including inverter-busy responses. Check session validity and register consistency before retrying; recognise already-applied commands without unnecessary replay.
- Expose fault and suspension details when commands fail or conflict with observed state.
- Let in-flight transactions finish before closing the shared connection.
- Reloading does not automatically reset or resume dispatch. A notification reports when an inverter dispatch may remain active.
- Apply polling options without reloading the integration. Fix cached readings expiring prematurely during slow polling.

#### Dashboard improvements

- Add **Manage AlphaESS dashboard automatically**, enabled by default. Turning it off preserves the existing dashboard while stopping automatic creation and layout updates.
- Restrict background refreshes to relevant AlphaESS registry changes.
- Serialize dashboard saves and recover interrupted saves without mistaking an updated memory cache for a successful disk write.
- Preserve backups and protect concurrent user edits. Optional frontend failures no longer prevent integration setup.
- Clarify grid-current descriptions: sign conventions depend on the inverter and meter. Reported readings are unchanged.

#### Behaviour changes to know

- Failed Force-mode and generic Dispatch starts or parameter changes now raise service errors. Normal HA scripts stop at a failed action.
- Raw `write_register` calls within `0x0880–0x088A` relinquish local dispatch sessions, preventing old controllers from reclaiming the command.
- Automatic dashboard management can replace manual edits to the managed default after backup. Disable management or use a separate copy for permanent customisations.
- Existing entity IDs are preserved. No PredBat dependency is introduced.
- Register addresses, encodings and the Dispatch Reset command block are unchanged. **Dispatch duration, ordering and retry behaviour do change as described above.**

#### Validation

400 Python tests passed in each of three compatibility environments covering HA 2024.12.5 and 2026.10.4 with pymodbus 3.7.4 and 3.16.1, plus 23 frontend tests. Coverage includes all dispatch-controller pairs, paused controllers, repeated charging/discharging updates, Mode 1/19 holds, queued stop/start ordering, eight-hour sessions, recovery-script failures, communication faults and interrupted dashboard saves. The stable release workflow gates publication on Python tests, frontend tests, HACS metadata and hassfest.

These are automated and simulated checks; they do not establish live inverter compatibility.

## Updating

Take a backup and update to **v1.21.2** through HACS during an idle dispatch period, then restart Home Assistant and refresh the frontend. Keep the configured integration and existing entities. Publishing this release does not install it into your Home Assistant.

Automatic dashboard management is enabled by default. Turn it off in the integration options to preserve manual changes to the default dashboard without automatic layout updates. With multiple inverters, one opted-out entry pauses management of the shared dashboard.

An inverter dispatch can remain active across a restart or integration reload; it is not resumed as a local controller. The notification gives its estimated expiry when known. Dispatch Reset remains the explicit stop action.

## Known limitation

Stop the active dispatch before changing Dispatch Mode. Changing the mode during a forced session can cause its next rewrite to report a consistency conflict and suspend automatic control. Generic Dispatch mode changes can restart its duration. Active-session mode selection remains a separate follow-up.

## Rollback

Select **v1.21.0** in HACS and restart Home Assistant to return to the previous stable release. A version rollback does not restore an earlier dashboard layout; restore the saved layout separately if needed.

See the [dashboard guide](https://github.com/PlainSeer/ha-alphaess-modbus-tcp/blob/v1.21.2/docs/saved-dashboard.md) and [dispatch lifecycle guide](https://github.com/PlainSeer/ha-alphaess-modbus-tcp/blob/v1.21.2/docs/dispatch-lifecycle.md) for details.
